terbaru.judul: Construction and Evolutionary Analysis of a Game Model for Supply Chain Finance Funding Based on Blockchain Technology
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper designs an operational framework for supply chain finance incorporating blockchain technology, clearly defines the participating entities, and analyzes their business relationships.

terbaru.judul: Data Certification Strategies for Blockchain-based Traceability Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we consider a typical system for blockchain-based traceability of a production process, and propose and comparatively analyze some strategies for certifying the data of such a process on blockchain, while maintaining the possibility of verifying their certification in a decentralized way.

terbaru.judul: AgriTrust: a Federated Semantic Governance Framework for Trusted Agricultural Data Sharing
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper introduces AgriTrust, a federated semantic governance framework designed to resolve this paradox.

terbaru.judul: ConneX: Automatically Resolving Transaction Opacity of Cross-Chain Bridges for Security Analysis
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this gap, we introduce ConneX, an automated and general-purpose system designed to accurately identify corresponding transaction pairs across both ends of cross-chain bridges.

terbaru.judul: Bunny Hops and Blockchain Stops: Cross-Chain MEV Detection With N-Hops
terbaru.pelajaran: This student paper introduces a novel methodology for the detection and analysis of multihop cross-chain arbitrage opportunities, wherein multihop denotes arbitrage sequences involving more than two transactional steps across distinct blockchain networks, executed using sequence-dependent strategies.

terbaru.judul: TRUST: A Decentralized Framework for Auditing Large Language Model Reasoning
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose TRUST, a transparent, decentralized auditing framework that overcomes these limitations via: (1) A consensus mechanism among diverse auditors, guaranteeing correctness under up to $30\%$ malicious participants.

terbaru.judul: Cross-Chain Sealed-Bid Auctions Using Confidential Compute Blockchains
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a sealed-bid auction protocol that executes sensitive bidding logic on a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE)-backed confidential compute blockchain while retaining settlement and enforcement on a public chain.

terbaru.judul: Fetch.ai: An Architecture for Modern Multi-Agent Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a novel, multi-layered solution built on a decentralized foundation of on-chain blockchain services for verifiable identity, discovery, and transactions.

terbaru.judul: Privacy-Preserving Healthcare Data in IoT: A Synergistic Approach with Deep Learning and Blockchain
terbaru.pelajaran: To tackle these challenges, we propose a comprehensive three-phase security framework designed to enhance the security and reliability of IoT-enabled healthcare systems.

terbaru.judul: Analysis of Input-Output Mappings in Coinjoin Transactions with Arbitrary Values
terbaru.pelajaran: We evaluate our method in detail on a set of emulated and real-world Wasabi 2.x coinjoins and extrapolate to its largest real-world coinjoins with hundreds of inputs and outputs.
